name: Google Sheets
description: Read and edit Google Sheets spreadsheets
author: flock

requires.rationale: A saved Google browser session is the reliable path for Sheets — no per-scope OAuth app review, and one session covers all Google skills.

auth.setup_instructions: Log in to your Google account via the browser session manager to access Sheets.

updateCells.reason: Types into the Sheets grid in the browser, then reads the cells back from the sheet's export to confirm them: 15-45s per call. A shorter limit kills a write that may still land, and the account stays busy for the next call.

appendRows.reason: Types into the Sheets grid in the browser, then reads the cells back from the sheet's export to confirm them: 15-45s per call. A shorter limit kills a write that may still land, and the account stays busy for the next call.

endpoints.purpose: Drive API (to list spreadsheets) and tokeninfo
